app: Diff-streaming session simulation (the per-session efficiency story)
channel_setup: 20-step interactive session (add row / type / status change / idle), send-once-then-deltas structured vs one screenshot per step.

t4_living_screen.detail: 20-step session: structured send-once+deltas = 626 tokens total vs 28,686 for per-step screenshots = 45.8x cheaper over the session. Per-step deltas: 94 tok (add row), 19 (type), 15 (status flip), 0 (idle). This is the resolution of the real-web ~parity: per single screen structure ties screenshots, but a screenshot pays its full ~1366 EVERY step while structure pays only for what changed and 0 when idle — and its stable identity reuses the prompt cache a per-pixel-changing screenshot cannot. The win is a property of the SESSION, not the screen.

measurements.notes: Closes definition-of-done item 5. The single strongest efficiency lever and the honest reframe of the cost claim: 'per-screen parity, per-session 45x'. Screenshots do not amortize; structure does.

runtime_verification.method: cumulative token accounting over 20 mechanical steps
